decision: 5 second time penalty (2 penalty points imposed, total of 7 points in the 12-month period)
event_name: Document 33 Date 11 October 2020 Time 15:29 2020 EIFEL GRAND PRIX 8 - 11 October 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Causing a collision with Car 26 after Turn 14.
offence: Involved in an incident as defined by Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 26 missed the apex of Turn 14 and re-joined the track. After that, Car 23 passed car 26, moved to the left and clipped the front wing of Car 26. This contact forced Car 26 into the pits to replace the front wing.
rules_referenced: Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 23 Causing A Collision With Car 26
